RollEntry.title: RollEntry
RollEntry.description: Administrator-only complete ledger roll record (301 to 400) storing entry count, display name, payment status, and private admin notes.

entries.description: Number of recorded entries for this roll.

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who last updated this entry.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

PublicRollSlip.title: PublicRollSlip
PublicRollSlip.description: Minimal non-PII single-roll summary (rollNumber, name, entries, updatedAt) for individual Person Login slip lookup.

entries.description: Number of recorded entries for this roll.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

LedgerSettings.title: LedgerSettings
LedgerSettings.description: Global ledger configuration including unit rate, currency symbol, and register title.

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol displayed next to calculated sums.

totalRolls.description: Total number of rolls in the register (100).

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who last updated settings.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized co-administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the co-administrator.

addedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/rolls/{rollId}.description: Full roll entries 301 through 400 (admin-only read, list, create, update, delete).

/publicRolls/{rollId}.description: Public single-roll slip lookup (get by exact rollId 301-400 only; list strictly forbidden; writes admin-only).

/settings/{settingId}.description: Global register settings (unitRate, currencySymbol, title) stored at /settings/ledger.

/admins/{userId}.description: Additional authorized administrator accounts granted by an existing admin.
